title: Steering Wheel Read
text: Receive Logitech G29 Steering Wheel read data, 5 outputs; {sampleTime} sets the sample time for steering wheel data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Buttons
ports.summary: Status of steering wheel buttons 0 (= unpressed) | 1 (= pressed)

ports.name: Steering
ports.summary: Value of steering wheel position 0 (= left most) | 65535 (= right most)

ports.name: Pedals
ports.summary: Status of throttle, brake, and clutch pedals 0 (= not engaged) | 255 (= fully engaged)

ports.name: Direction
ports.summary: Status of direction pad buttons on steering wheel 0 (= UP) | 2 (= RIGHT) | 4 (= DOWN) | 6 (= LEFT) | 8 (= UNPRESSED)

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: Status of communications with steering wheel 0 (default) | negative value

params.name: sampleTime
params.values: Sample time for steering wheel data -1 (inherited) (default)
